senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. שָׁלָה)to strike off, chip.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Makkot 2:6">Tosef. Macc. II, 6</cite> <he>נ׳ הברזל מן העץ המתבקע</he> if the iron (axe) chipped a piece off the wood which was to be split (and the chip struck a person dead); v. <cite ref="N01313"><he>נְשִׁילָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> <he>נָשְׁלוּ איבריו</he> his limbs fell off (by decay; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:7">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>נָשְׁרוּ</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite> <he>נשרן</he>, <he>נשרין</he>, ch.).

senses.gloss: to strike off, to cause chips to fly off. Ib. ונִישֵּׁל כתיב v’nashal (Deut. XIX, 5) may be read v’nishshel (Pi.) and the iron chips off a part of the wood &c., v. supra; ונָשַׁל קרינן the traditional reading is v’nashal, and the iron slips out of the helve (v. אֵם).

units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37">Lev. R. s. 37</cite>, end <he>שהיה נ׳ ממנו אבר אבר וכ׳</he> limb after limb fell off his body and was buried each in a different place; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37">ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ אבר אבר</he>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:15">Koh. R. to X, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:21">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>יהא בשרה נ׳</he> her flesh (limbs) shall fall off; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 5:1">Bets. V, 1</cite> <he>מַשִּׁילִין פירות וכ׳</he> you may let down fruit (that was spread on the roof) through the aperture &c.; (versions ib. 35ᵇ: <he>משחילין</he>, <he>משירין</he>, <he>מנשירין</he>, <he>משחירין</he>).
